exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Data from Information Repositories
exploitedBy.relevance: Insufficient sensitivity classification enables attackers to access and exfiltrate data from repositories without triggering appropriate access controls or alerts.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Gather Victim Identity Information
exploitedBy.relevance: Improperly classified sensitive data can expose identity information that adversaries gather for reconnaissance and targeting purposes.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Lifecycle-Triggered Deletion
exploitedBy.relevance: Undefined retention schedules can be exploited or misconfigured to trigger premature or improper deletion of data through lifecycle policies.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Stored Data Manipulation
exploitedBy.relevance: Without enforced retention schedules, stored data is vulnerable to manipulation or tampering over extended periods without detection.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: File Deletion
exploitedBy.relevance: Unenforced retention policies leave no guardrails to prevent unauthorized or premature deletion of files that should be preserved.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: IP Addresses
exploitedBy.relevance: Absence of masking for quasi-identifiers such as IP addresses exposes network identity information that adversaries can collect and use.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Automated Collection
exploitedBy.relevance: Excessive read permissions on metadata aggregates facilitate automated bulk collection of sensitive information by adversaries.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Cloud Groups
exploitedBy.relevance: Overly broad access to metadata aggregates often stems from misconfigured cloud group permissions that grant unintended read access.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Log Enumeration
exploitedBy.relevance: Unencrypted log fields allow adversaries who enumerate logs to directly read sensitive information without needing to bypass any cryptographic protections.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Credentials In Files
exploitedBy.relevance: Sensitive log fields lacking encryption may contain credentials stored in plaintext that adversaries can directly extract.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Data from Cloud Storage
exploitedBy.relevance: Missing encryption at rest for cloud-stored log fields exposes sensitive data to adversaries who gain access to cloud storage resources.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Transmitted Data Manipulation
exploitedBy.relevance: Cross-border transfers of operational metadata are at risk of interception and manipulation in transit by adversaries or state actors.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Determine Physical Locations
exploitedBy.relevance: Operational metadata transferred across borders can reveal physical location information that adversaries use for reconnaissance.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Data Destruction
exploitedBy.relevance: Inadequate disposal procedures fail to ensure complete and irreversible data destruction, leaving residual data recoverable by adversaries.
